title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode15 That Which You Give

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I had no idea.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That must be why Haruka said she has no right to be an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
I've regretted what I said ever since.
I think about it every day...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
Haruka gave me hope more times than I can count. I looked up to her. She was my most important friend, and yet...
How could I have said such horrible things?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: So when I heard that Haruka was retiring, all I could see was that same darkness again.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I just knew it was my fault.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I need to apologize to her.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I know apologizing probably won't change anything, but still... I have to tell her I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: ...Look, whatever's going on between you two isn't really our business,

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: but if there's something you want to let her know, you should just tell her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. Even if you've caused her pain in the past, talking about it will help you move forward.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Momoi... Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Thank you so much.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Haruka sure is late.
She was supposed to be here by now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She probably got stopped by someone on the way. Let's give her a little more time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Is it really a good idea to let Haruka see Mai?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What if it just makes her feel even worse? But if they don't talk, I'll worry about Mai.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know you're worried.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I think it's more painful to let two friends continue misunderstanding one another. At least, that's how I felt.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry to keep you waiting. What did you want to... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai? What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I'm sorry for showing up so suddenly like this, but I just had to come apologize.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Haruka, I'm truly sorry!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
The things I said to you back then.
All this time, I've been wondering how I could have said such horrible things!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I kept thinking I needed to apologize, and then I heard you quit being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry!
I know it's too late for my apology to do anything, but...

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: It's my fault that you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mai, look at me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry too, Mai. I've wanted to apologize as well. I pushed you too hard and wasn't able to do anything to help when you suffered as a result.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And you have it wrong, Mai.
It's not your fault that I quit being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I simply wanted to study as a normal student. I wanted to see what it was like to not be an idol. That's why—

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: You're lying!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: We worked together long enough that even I know that's not what you really think!

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: I'm...sorry...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Really, that's all there was to it.
There's no reason for you to feel responsible.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But thank you so much for coming all the way to see me, Mai.

rows.Speaker: Mai
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for tricking you into coming like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's fine. I'm sure you were all just worried about me because of what I said yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, yeah.
But are you sure you're okay just quitting like this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's true that the reason I felt as though I didn't have the right to be an idol was due to what happened with Mai.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But she can't ever know that.
I don't want her to keep regretting what happened in the past.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I honestly don't have any regrets from my time as an idol. I did everything I was able to. Besides...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have nothing more I can give.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's not true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's not true that you have nothing more to give.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You gave me so much hope!
You're the reason I'm able to try so hard to become an idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No matter how many times I fail, I never give up! And that's because you gave me hope to keep looking forward!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So please don't...don't say that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori. It makes me happy to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I really don't have anything left to give.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After all, no matter how much I want to get up on stage, I just can't.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?
